label: Low-rate commitment
evidence: continue to hold the target range for the federal funds rate at its current level until the economy reaches conditions consistent with maximum employment
next_meeting_pricing: September meeting odds unavailable for this comparison.

label: Further tightening
evidence: as the stance of monetary policy tightens further
next_meeting_pricing: 75 bp hike probability, 56.5% before and 60.5% afterwards.
pricing_interpretation: With 50 and 75 bp as the two outcomes, implied tightening rose from 64.13 to 65.13 bp. The source gives no quote times, so other news could enter the 1.00 bp change.

label: Conditional tightening
evidence: prepared to raise rates further if appropriate
next_meeting_pricing: 25 bp hike probability, 19.5% at 10:00 and 21.5% at 10:20 ET.
pricing_interpretation: Powell spoke at 10:05. Across this 20-minute window the expected move rose from +4.88 to +5.38 bp. By 15:00 it was back to +4.88 bp. The initial repricing was half a basis point and had unwound by mid-afternoon.

label: Easing signalled
evidence: the timing and pace of rate cuts will depend on incoming data
next_meeting_pricing: The reported probability of a 25 bp cut fell 0.5 percentage points before the speech, from 76.5% on 16 August to 76% on 22 August.
pricing_interpretation: Market participants were already choosing between a 25 and 50 bp cut. Thursday’s probabilities implied 31.00 bp of easing. By Friday afternoon the reported probability of 50 bp was 36.5%, equivalent to 34.13 bp of easing. The additional 3.13 bp spans a prior-day to afternoon interval.

label: Conditional easing
evidence: the baseline outlook and the shifting balance of risks may warrant adjusting our policy stance
next_meeting_pricing: September cut probability, 75% the day before and 91.5% after the speech.
pricing_interpretation: The reported probability rose 16.5 percentage points. The report gives the chance of a cut without a complete distribution by size, so the change is displayed in probability points. The interval includes overnight news.
